title: Hands up in Pelican Valley #Shorts
description:
March 1894. An Army scout follows snowshoe tracks through Pelican Valley and finds Ed Howell, the most notorious poacher in Yellowstone, bent over a dead bison.

▶ Full documentary (Part 2, When the Cavalry Guarded the Geysers): https://youtu.be/P99Gu3GCZVw
